primary_endpoint: Improvement in liver fibrosis (decrease ≥1 stage) without worsening of MASH at week 24; week-96 evaluation also reported.
efficacy_outcome: At week 96, fibrosis improvement without MASH worsening occurred in 19% with placebo, 30% with efruxifermin 28 mg (difference 12 percentage points; p=0.19), and 49% with 50 mg (difference 31 percentage points; p=0.0030).
safety_signal: Adverse events were reported by 95% (28 mg), 100% (50 mg), and 98% (placebo); mild-to-moderate gastrointestinal events were more common with efruxifermin. No drug-induced liver injury or deaths were reported.
